A '''clone commando''' who wore [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] was a member of the [[High Orbit Precision Entry Squad]], also known as H.O.P.E. Squad, around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. His [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] made use of a [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinder]]. He and his squad were sent to [[Mission to Yorn Skot|assist]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Treetower]] on [[Yorn Skot]] near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Treetower had been attempting to intercept [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] goods being [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], but had been knocked unconscious and was left to hang on a unipod underneath the landing platform that contained the goods. After a successful landing on the platform, the [[Unidentified orange commando|commando leader]] ordered that they rappel down the platform's side to retrieve the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Mid-way they were ambushed by [[B2-AA air assault super battle droid|jump droids]], and the [[Clone commando/Legends|commando]] was killed along with two others in the attack. Only the squad leader survived and ended up completing the mission.
